content.short: IntentX is an intent-based perpetual futures DEX on Base and Mantle offering over 260 trading pairs.
content.description:
IntentX is a next-generation decentralized perpetual exchange that utilizes a cutting-edge intent-based architecture to provide professional-grade trading. Operating on both Base and Mantle, the platform offers over 260 trading pairs with up to 60x leverage, all settled through the SYMMIO protocol. Unlike traditional order books, IntentX's model relies on bilateral trade agreements, ensuring deep liquidity and minimal slippage for even the most complex trades.

On the Mantle network, IntentX heavily utilizes USDe as collateral, allowing traders to earn Ethena rewards while maintaining active positions. The platform is powered by the INTX token, with a revenue-sharing model that incentivizes long-term stakers. By combining the speed of intent-based execution with the security of on-chain settlement, IntentX is redefining the standards for decentralized derivatives and empowering traders with unparalleled flexibility.
